notes: Requires a Gezel build with Ming support and stable-diffusion.cpp master-951-f89d9b1 or newer. Use 12 steps, CFG 1, Euler, and dimensions divisible by 16. Keep the Ling text encoder in BF16. Text-to-image only; the separate Design-Layer model is not included. BF16 avoids the missing INT8 matrix kernel observed on Metal with this engine pin. A 1024px design poster passed end-to-end testing on a 128 GB Apple M5 Max; memory guidance is conservative, not a measured minimum. Local generation took approximately 5–7 minutes with VAE tiling. Transparent-background output is not validated on this Metal build: both a generic transparency request and the documented RGBA prefix produced opaque white backgrounds, while PNG bytes were preserved unchanged. Upstream transparency guidance: https://github.com/inclusionAI/Ming-Image#transparent-background-generation-tip.
